# Code Anchors: Distiller

- `.claude/commands/nxs.distill.md` — the drain agent: preflight and the run-mode gate, per-mode diff recomputation (single-repo range-first, introducing-commit scan as fallback), the single-entry continuation mode on a close-prepared distill branch, per-concept delta synthesis (best-fit domain filing and the three-way taxonomy gate), the deterministic steps (reciprocity, anchor refresh, atlas, validator, drift advisory, hub-vs-single-repo invocation), the ban on reading per-user scratch, checkpoint, and PR; resolves the why per entry — the record issue body hash-verified against the close stamp (hard-error on mismatch, no waiver), else a committed decision record, else the close record — and follows the resolved docs root for the atlas.
